reviewed_entries.source: Welcome to the Globulation 2 primary tutorial! This tutorial will cover everything from building inns, exploring zones, and destroying enemies! There is no shortage of useful knowledge here!
reviewed_entries.target: Globulation 2 च्या मुख्य ट्युटोरियलमध्ये आपले स्वागत आहे! या ट्युटोरियलमध्ये धर्मशाळा बांधण्यापासून, झोन शोधण्यापर्यंत आणि शत्रूंना नष्ट करण्यापर्यंत सर्व काही शिकवले जाईल! येथे उपयुक्त ज्ञानाची अजिबात कमतरता नाही!

reviewed_entries.source: Now that you have mastered the basics, it's time to get used to other buildings such as Racetracks, Swimming Pools, and Schools.
reviewed_entries.target: आता तुम्ही मूलभूत गोष्टींमध्ये पारंगत झाला आहात, त्यामुळे रेसट्रॅक, जलतरण तलाव आणि शाळा यांसारख्या इतर इमारतींची सवय करून घेण्याची वेळ आली आहे.

reviewed_entries.source: You have done well to get this far. Now let's move on to Warriors, Barracks, and Upgrades.
reviewed_entries.target: तुम्ही इथपर्यंत पोहोचून चांगली कामगिरी केली आहे. आता आपण वॉरियर्स, बॅरॅक्स आणि अपग्रेड्सकडे वळूया.

reviewed_entries.source: You are almost finished. Only flags and attacking remain. Then you'll know enough to try Custom Games and eventually play online against some of Globulation 2's finest players.
reviewed_entries.target: तुमचं काम जवळजवळ पूर्ण झालं आहे. फक्त फ्लॅग्ज आणि अटॅकिंग बाकी आहे. त्यानंतर तुम्हाला कस्टम गेम्स खेळून पाहण्याइतकं ज्ञान मिळेल आणि अखेरीस तुम्ही Globulation 2 च्या काही सर्वोत्कृष्ट खेळाडूंविरुद्ध ऑनलाइन खेळू शकाल.

findings.reason: Use a Marathi description consistently across all three related labels.
Shift is transliterated while Ctrl remains Latin; both should match actual keyboard legends.
Drag remains English while the parallel box explanation is inconsistent.

माझे प्रकाशन is singular/inflexible against multiple published releases.

glossary_recommendations.unit: युनिट (unchanged count noun), consistently; avoid alternating with एकक
glossary_recommendations.register: Consistent respectful तुम्ही / तुमचा / करा; avoid colloquial तुमचं/तुम्हाला ... इतकं in the same tutorial

verdict: Do not publish this pilot unchanged. Google NMT is usable as a rough draft; bulk drafting may proceed only with glossary locked and these systematic ambiguities assigned to full-catalog reviewers. Protected format tokens survive, but keyboard legends need manual protection/review beyond interpolation tokens. No large Hindi-contamination pattern found; several Marathi words are shared with Hindi legitimately. Main defects are English-sense ambiguity, English transliterations, and inconsistent technical nouns.
snapshot: Original 100-message Google pilot before semantic edits; original outputs recovered from immutable Google response cache. Later bulk drafts are not reviewed by this record.
